source.validation: Exact public Git source at the fixed comparison revision. Claims are static observations. No runtime, build, lint or live accessibility validation ran.

text:
loader: taskgraph.loader.transform:loader

transforms:
    - taskgraph.transforms.from_deps
    - gecko_taskgraph.transforms.repackage_l10n
    - gecko_taskgraph.transforms.name_sanity
    - gecko_taskgraph.transforms.repackage
    - gecko_taskgraph.transforms.repackage_routes
    - gecko_taskgraph.transforms.job
    - gecko_taskgraph.transforms.task

kind-dependencies:
    - shippable-l10n

only-for-build-platforms:
    # Langpacks support all CPU architectures. We just need to pick one
    - linux64-shippable/opt

tasks:
    repackage-deb-l10n:
        from-deps:
            group-by: single-with-filters
        worker-type: b-linux
        worker:
            docker-image: {"in-tree": "debian12-repackage"}
            max-run-time: 600
        mozharness:
            use-caches: [checkout]
            comm-checkout: true
            clone-with: hg
            config-paths:
                - comm/testing/mozharness/configs
            config:
                by-build-platform:
                    linux64-enterprise\b.*:
                        - repackage/base.py
                        - repackage/base_enterprise.py
                        - repackage/linux64_signed.py
                    linux64(?!-enterprise)\b.*:
                        - repackage/base.py
                        - repackage/linux64_signed.py
        package-formats:
            by-build-platform:
                linux.*: [deb-l10n]
        treeherder-group: Deb-l10n
